# Richael
Auckland, New Zealand  |  [huangd6666@gmail.com](mailto:huangd6666@gmail.com)
[dh8116.github.io](https://dh8116.github.io)  |  [github.com/dh8116](https://github.com/dh8116)  |  [x.com/RicaV42](https://x.com/RicaV42)

## PROFILE
I'm 16, in Auckland, building Soulor ([soulor.app](https://soulor.app/)): an AI app that lets a manager rehearse a hard conversation before they have it, and gives the business a one-page report that behaviour changed.

## STAGE
- Live in six languages, billing switched on: 14 accounts created, 0 paying.
- 2 users have run a real situation through it and written feedback.
- Target: 3 paying pilots by 20 November 2026.

## THE BUYER
- Contact centres handling stalled applications: a two-week pilot, with one metric agreed before it starts, reported per cohort at the end.
- Paid from the team's coaching and training budget. I'm still sizing that budget, so there is no market figure here yet.

## HOW I WORK
- Diagnosed my own funnel: sign-ups were stalling at the confirmation email (8 of 14 accounts confirmed), so I put Google sign-in first, with no email to wait for, and shipped it the same day.
- A tester said the voice call "won't respond". I traced it to a call that never listened and only played canned lines, switched it off and rebuilt it as a real listening call the same evening.
- I measure before I claim: making each simulated person's relationship a stake cut stock replies ("no worries", "I get it") from 5 to 1 on messages held out from tuning.

## TECHNICAL PROOF
- Nine Triton GPU kernels in nine weeks, each benchmarked against PyTorch; fused cross-entropy runs 1.51x faster with 1.67x less peak memory at vocab 131,072.
- Fine-tuned Qwen3-14B with LoRA for $1.30 of compute and built cold-start routing that took replies from 5.7s to 2.3s.
- Leading a five-person research paper on verifier error in reinforcement learning for language models (RLVR), targeting COLM/TMLR.

## EDUCATION & AWARDS
Year 11, Auckland, New Zealand (IB Math AA HL, NCEA Level 2). Expected graduation 2028
- AIME 10/15 | AMC 12 Honor Roll (Top 5%) | HiMCM and IMMC regional Honorable Mentions

# Richael
Auckland, New Zealand  |  [huangd6666@gmail.com](mailto:huangd6666@gmail.com)
[dh8116.github.io](https://dh8116.github.io)  |  [github.com/dh8116](https://github.com/dh8116)  |  [x.com/RicaV42](https://x.com/RicaV42)

## PROFILE
A student researcher working on reinforcement learning for language models and on GPU kernels. Leading a five-person paper on verifier error in RLVR, and publishing one Triton kernel a week, each benchmarked against PyTorch with its numbers.

## RESEARCH
### RLVR verifier persistence — team lead, five-person paper
Aug 2026 – present. Targeting COLM/TMLR
- Two published results disagree: systematic verifier errors collapse training, while natural persistent errors in real code test suites do no harm. We hold the aggregate error rate and asymmetry fixed and sweep persistence (coverage × targeting) to produce one phase map on which both results are single points.
- Mechanism under test: a persistent error corrupts every rollout of a prompt identically, so it moves the GRPO group mean, which is the baseline.
- Scoped as an explanation, not a new algorithm or a state-of-the-art claim. Five streams: past-paper analysis, code, data, modelling, analysis.

## GPU SYSTEMS & OPTIMIZATION
One Triton kernel per week, benchmarked against PyTorch and written up at [dh8116.github.io/blog](https://dh8116.github.io/blog).
- Cut fused cross-entropy to 15.90 ms against PyTorch's 24.03 ms at vocab 131,072 (1.51x), at 1.67x less peak memory, by collapsing five live copies of the logits tensor to three.
- Raised fused softmax from ~55 GB/s to ~230 GB/s, and established T4's ~240 GB/s practical ceiling by measurement.

## MACHINE LEARNING & EVALUATION
- Fine-tuned Qwen3-14B with LoRA on a 1,526-row corpus spanning five generation paths in six languages, for $1.30 of compute; served it behind vLLM at 2.3s against the 5.7s model it replaced.
- Built held-out evaluations for a production dialogue model: tuned on one set of messages, judged on another. Making each persona's relationship a stake cut stock replies from 5 to 1; an observer-only prompt cut unrequested advice from 11 to 3.
- Fine-tuned MusicGen-small for bar-locked stems and built the eval harness that scores clips the way production uses them.

## PROJECTS
- Soulor ([soulor.app](https://soulor.app/)), founder, May 2026 – present: an AI app to rehearse a hard conversation against a simulated version of the other person; live in six languages.
- VNportal ([vnportal.vercel.app](https://vnportal.vercel.app/)), May 2026 – present: music community platform with AI stem generation.

## EDUCATION & AWARDS
Year 11, Auckland, New Zealand. Expected graduation 2028. IB Math AA HL, NCEA Level 2
- Score 10/15, AIME | Honor Roll (Top 5%), AMC 12 | High Distinction, Australian Mathematics Competition
- Honorable Mention, HiMCM; Honorable Mention, IMMC regional; co-authored the modelling papers for both
